result:
Both UK-side entries for the March close are posted and supported:

- **JE-00305** — Management fee from US parent: Dr 6550 Intercompany Management Fees / Cr 2300 Intercompany Payable, GBP 12,000.00 (USD 15,000 ÷ 1.2500 March policy rate). Supported by DOC-0206 and DOC-0201. Since this exceeds the USD 10,000 senior-accountant threshold, I submitted it for Controller approval per policy — it's now pending.

- **JE-00306** — Intercompany loan remeasurement: Dr 6950 FX Gain/Loss / Cr 2400 Intercompany Loan Payable, GBP 2,519.69, remeasuring the USD 200,000 loan from GBP 157,480.31 (1.2700 drawdown rate) to GBP 160,000.00 (1.2500 March month-end rate). Supported by DOC-0016 and DOC-0201. Well under the approval threshold, no further routing needed.

No unsupportable items arose, so nothing required flagging as an exception. Memo submitted to the controller.
